name: Cash & ATM Concurrent Audit Checklist
description: Monthly verification of cash handling, retention limits, and ATM reconciliation

checklistItems.item: Physical cash count matches book balance
Cash retention limit compliance verified
Denomination breakdown recorded and verified
ATM balances reconciled with book balance
Dual custody maintained for cash handling
Cash transit insurance policy valid and adequate
Mutilated/soiled notes segregated and reported to RBI

name: Investment Portfolio Concurrent Audit Checklist
description: Monthly review of investment transactions, SLR compliance, and broker limits

checklistItems.item: SLR maintenance ratio verified against RBI requirement
Investment Committee approval obtained for transactions above threshold
SGL/CSGL account reconciled with RBI
HTM/HFT/AFS classification verified as per policy
Broker exposure limit (5% cap) compliance checked
Market valuation of AFS/HFT portfolio done

name: Advances Concurrent Audit Checklist
description: Monthly review of loan sanctioning, disbursement, and asset quality

checklistItems.item: Loan sanctions comply with delegation of powers
Credit appraisal notes and bureau reports on file
Disbursement made only after all documentation complete
Collateral valuation reports current (< 3 years old)
Insurance coverage adequate and valid
SMA-0/1/2 accounts identified and monitored
NPA classification as per 90-day overdue rule
Provisioning adequacy verified

name: Off-Balance Sheet Items Concurrent Audit Checklist
description: Monthly verification of contingent liabilities and guarantees

checklistItems.item: Bank guarantees issued with proper approval and margin
Letters of Credit comply with UCPDC 600 guidelines
Off-balance sheet exposures within Board-approved limits
Contingent liability disclosure accurate in financials
Expired guarantees/LCs closed promptly

name: Deposits Concurrent Audit Checklist
description: Monthly review of deposit accounts, interest rates, and compliance

checklistItems.item: Interest rates applied as per approved rate card
KYC compliance verified for new accounts
Premature withdrawal penalty computation accurate
Unclaimed deposits identified and transferred to DEA fund (if applicable)
Nominee registration compliance checked
Deposit insurance (DICGC) premium paid timely

name: KYC/AML Concurrent Audit Checklist
description: Monthly verification of KYC compliance and AML controls

checklistItems.item: New accounts opened only with complete KYC documents
Periodic KYC updates done as per risk category
High-risk customer transactions monitored
STRs filed with FIU-IND within 7 days
CTRs (Cash Transaction Reports) filed for transactions ≥ ₹10 lakhs
PEP (Politically Exposed Persons) accounts identified and monitored
AML training conducted for branch staff

name: EDP/IT Concurrent Audit Checklist
description: Quarterly review of CBS operations, access controls, and IT security

checklistItems.item: User access rights reviewed and inactive users disabled
Daily CBS backup successful and verified
Change management process followed for CBS changes
Audit trail logging enabled and monitored
Anti-virus definitions updated on all systems
Firewall logs reviewed for unauthorized access attempts
Patch management up to date for critical systems
Disaster Recovery (DR) drill conducted quarterly
